bibliographic-data.invention-title: ARTICLE À FUMER ÉLECTRONIQUE AVEC RÉTROACTION HAPTIQUE
ELECTRONIC SMOKING ARTICLE WITH HAPTIC FEEDBACK

nplcit.text: - "Chemical and Biological Studies on New Cigarette Prototypes that Heat Instead of Burn Tobacco", R. J. Reynolds Tobacco Company Monograph (1988

abstract.p: An electronic smoking article comprising: a control body formed of a housing that includes: a control component; a sensor; a battery; an LED; a haptic feedback component; and a haptic driver; and a cartridge formed of a housing that includes: a reservoir; a heater; a transport element adapted to transport an aerosol precursor composition stored in the reservoir to the heater; and an opening in the housing that allows for egress of formed aerosol from the cartridge; wherein the cartridge is adapted to engage the control body through a press-fit engagement to establish a connection between the control body and the cartridge as well as to establish an electrical connection between the battery and the control component in the control body and the heater in the cartridge; and wherein the haptic driver is in electrical communication with the control component and a haptic feedback component such that the control component and the haptic driver direct the haptic feedback component to form haptic feedback that is defined by different waveforms.
